# `Q-5-32` — Render Pattern Reaches Into Nested Project

> A `project.render` pattern names files inside a nested project (a
> subdirectory with its own `_quarto.yml`). They render as part of
> this project, with this project's config.

## What this means

A subdirectory with its own `_quarto.yml` (or `_quarto.yaml`) is a
nested project. Implicit patterns skip it (see
[`Q-5-31`](Q-5-31.qmd)). A pattern that **names the nested
directory** is explicit, though, so its matches still render in the
outer project:

```yaml
project:
  render:
    - index.qmd
    - sub/page.qmd     # sub/ has its own _quarto.yml
```

Here `sub/page.qmd` renders into the outer site with the outer
project's chrome and metadata. The nested `sub/_quarto.yml` does not
apply. `q2 render sub` would render the same page with the nested
config instead. The warning says so because it's easy to miss.

A pattern counts as explicit when the directories it names before
its first wildcard reach the nested directory or go below it:

| Pattern          | Explicit for `sub/`? |
|------------------|----------------------|
| `sub/page.qmd`   | yes                  |
| `sub/*.qmd`      | yes                  |
| `sub/**/*.qmd`   | yes                  |
| `sub`            | yes (a bare directory means everything under it) |
| `**/*.qmd`       | no, so `sub/` is skipped |
| `*/page.qmd`     | no, so `sub/` is skipped |

If `sub/` itself contains a deeper nested project, such as
`sub/deeper/_quarto.yml`, naming `sub` does not reach into
`sub/deeper`. The pattern has to name `sub/deeper` itself.

## How to fix it

- **The files belong to the outer project.** Move the nested
  `_quarto.yml` out of the directory, or rename it to `_metadata.yml`
  if it only holds settings for that directory. The warning then
  goes away.
- **The directory really is a separate project.** Remove the
  pattern from the outer `project.render`, and render the nested
  project on its own with `q2 render sub`.
- **You deliberately render these pages in both places.** The
  warning is informational. It is reported once for the whole
  project, so the `diagnostics:` key cannot silence it yet.
